description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItem API endpoints in the eShopOnWeb project. It verifies pagination behavior and concurrent request handling.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for catalog item API endpoints, verifying pagination and parallel request handling.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that the endpoint returns the first 10 catalog items when pageSize=10.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Verifies that requesting pageIndex=1 returns the correct set of catalog items based on total count and page size.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Tests that multiple parallel GET requests to various endpoints succeed with status OK.
